name: OpenCloud
short_desc: Self-hosted file sync and share platform, the community fork of ownCloud Infinite Scale.
author: OpenCloud GmbH
description: OpenCloud is a modern file sync and share platform written in Go. It stores files directly on disk without a database and comes with a built-in identity provider, WebDAV, sharing, spaces and desktop/mobile clients.

form_fields.label: Admin password
form_fields.hint: Password for the 'admin' user. Only used on the first start; change it later in OpenCloud itself.

form_fields.label: Skip TLS certificate checks
form_fields.hint: Keep enabled when using the local domain (self-signed certificate). Disable when exposing on a public domain with a Let's Encrypt certificate.

form_fields.label: Default language
form_fields.hint: Two-letter language code for the web UI and emails, e.g. en or de.
form_fields.pattern_error: Use a two-letter language code, e.g. en or de.
